name: ETH Zurich
summary: Swiss federal university of science and technology in Zurich; its bachelor's degrees are taught in German, with a strict IB subject rule.

ib.text: 38/42 points; HL Maths (AA or AI), HL physics, chemistry or biology and HL Language A, plus three set SL subjects, or a German entrance exam (2026/27 list). German C1 certificate by 31 March.

dates.label: Application closes, 23:59 CET; no late applications
IB Diploma due: upload on receipt, by this date at the latest

notes: You may apply for one bachelor's programme only.
If your IB subjects miss the exam-free rule, an application in the December 2026 to March 2027 window leads to the entrance exam in January 2028 and a start in September 2028.
Only a listed German certificate or German as your mother tongue meets the language rule; school certificates showing German, even at C2, are not accepted in its place.
